# FLUX 3 Klein seed sweep

**Workflow:** [`flux3/flux3-klein-seed-sweep.json`](../flux3/flux3-klein-seed-sweep.json)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Family | `flux3` |
| Nodes | 13 |
| Links | 12 |
| Paid API calls per run | **4** |

---

Four Klein edits of one image at four fixed seeds, batched onto one sheet, so you pick the take you want and keep its seed for every later run.

Every run bills **four** Klein calls. Toggle a take's group off in **Fast Groups Bypasser** to spend less; copy one to spend more. A bypassed take passes the source through, so its slot on the sheet shows the original.

**Anything Everywhere** sends the loaded image to every Klein node's `input_image` (filter `^input_image$`), so a fifth take needs no wiring — drop in a Klein node and give it a new seed.

The seeds are **1001–1004**, all **fixed**, so the sheet is reproducible. The prompt is the same for all four, which keeps the seed the only variable.

Three core **Batch Images** nodes stack the takes into one batch for a single Save Image, in seed order. Batch Images rescales to the first image's size if the takes differ, which they will not here: every take keeps the source size.

### Needs
[rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy) and [Use Everywhere](https://github.com/chrisgoringe/cg-use-everywhere). **Manager → Install Missing Custom Nodes** finds both if the graph loads with red nodes. If Use Everywhere is missing, the model nodes get no image and run as **text-to-image** — install it before you queue.

## The prompt lives in one node

The **Shared Prompt** node feeds every FLUX 3 `prompt` in this graph, so there is one
place to edit it. It emits a plain string, **not** a list, so each node it feeds still runs once.
